description: Connect a new email mailbox by its IMAP + SMTP credentials (passwords encrypted at rest). Only email_address, provider and the two passwords are required — hosts, ports and usernames default to the provider's published settings, so OMIT them unless the mailbox lives on a non-standard server. Nearly every provider requires an app-specific password rather than the account password (465=SSL, 587=STARTTLS). Do NOT assume the username is the email address: iCloud wants the bare local part for IMAP and the full address for SMTP, and omitting both usernames gets each one right automatically. Use provider=generic_imap for a self-hosted server — it infers nothing, so supply all six connection fields.

imap_host.description: IMAP server hostname (omit to use the provider default)

imap_port.description: IMAP port (omit to use the provider default, usually 993)

imap_username.description: IMAP login username (omit to use the shape this provider expects)

poll_interval_seconds.description: Per-mailbox poll cadence (min 60, max 86400). Omit for the platform default of 300s. Can only make a mailbox poll LESS often than the 300s platform tick, never more — a smaller value does not deliver mail sooner, it gets the account rate-limited by its own provider.

provider.description: Email provider. gmail = personal Gmail; google_workspace = a Workspace domain account; generic_imap = self-hosted or unlisted.

smtp_host.description: SMTP server hostname (omit to use the provider default)

smtp_port.description: SMTP port (omit to use the provider default)

smtp_username.description: SMTP login username (omit to use the shape this provider expects)

sync_scope.description: How far back to import on first connect. OMIT for the default (last_n, 500), which is almost always right. all imports the ENTIRE history at ~100 messages per 5 minutes (~28,800/day) and stores it in full — a 100,000-message mailbox takes ~3.5 days, and some providers (Gmail especially) rate-limit an import that large, which can stall the mailbox entirely. Pass all ONLY when the user explicitly asked for their whole archive.

sync_scope_n.description: Message count for sync_scope=last_n (default 500, max 100000). An UPPER bound, not exact: the start point comes from the folder's UIDNEXT and UIDs are sparse where mail was deleted, so fewer than N may arrive — never more. Must be OMITTED when sync_scope is all or since_date.

sync_since_date.description: Cutoff date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) for sync_scope=since_date. Required with that scope; must be omitted otherwise.

name: create_mailbox
